items.title: Sid Davilla Interview, 1969-04-17
items.q: And, uh, we put Lizzy on the street with a piano player, on the stage with a piano player.

ctx.x: Yeah, he plays up there on the 600 blocks.

And he's just, uh, great. Yes, great. But that seems to be the thing now I see with, uh, for popularity. So we're getting back to, it's not folk music and it's not completely blues, but it is a, I believe it's sort of a combination of folk, rhythm, and blues. The style that's evolving now, or gelling, you know, which would be popular for a while. And I hate to think what the next one will be, I don't know. But Lizzy was here, Lizzy Miles, she, um, I met Lizzy on a radio interview. Tony Almericka used to have a…
What about the El Moraco? That was the place where they used to have some, um, George used to play there.
